description: Reduce num_bins to 8 (T change breaks checkpoint compatibility due to PSN [T,T] weight shapes)
spike_th=0.1 (binarize input): -40.2% SOPs but +330% AEE, too aggressive
spike_th=0.02: counterintuitive - INCREASED firing (+36%) vs baseline, AEE still bad (6.59). Binarization disrupts input stats
norm_input=std: z-score norm increased firing (+44%) and destroyed accuracy (AEE 8.07). Model expects minmax-trained input distribution
Identity Token Mixer (no QKV attention, 5 epochs): SOPs -18.6% vs PSN baseline, AEE +32.7%. QKV attention confirmed redundant in SNN transformer!
Conv Token Mixer (5 epochs): SOPs -16.9% vs PSN, AEE=2.16. Worse than Identity and Pool
Pool Token Mixer (5 epochs): BEST so far! SOPs -18.4%, AEE=2.01. Simplest design wins
